Preamble.Description: Incorporation of new study results, medications, or devices that merit modification of existing clinical practice guideline recommendations is critical.
Preamble.Organizational Involvement: American College of Cardiology (ACC) and American Heart Association (AHA) Task Force
Preamble.Process: The update is subject to rigorous, multilevel review and approval.
Preamble.Objective: Ensure guidelines reflect current knowledge, treatment options, and optimal medical care.

Modernization.Process: Adoption of a knowledge byte format addressing a specific clinical question.
Modernization.Benefits: Facilitates easier access to recommendations and supports evolution of guidelines.
Modernization.Example: Includes concise text hyperlinked to supportive evidence.

Class of Recommendation and Level of Evi.Purpose: Indicates the strength of recommendation, encompassing estimated magnitude and certainty of benefit.
Class of Recommendation and Level of Evi.Subcategories: LOE B and C subcategorized for increased granularity.

Relationships with Industry.Policy: GWC members and reviewers must disclose industry relationships. Managed by RWI avoidance and declaration.
Relationships with Industry.Transparency: Disclosure information available in online supplement.

Intended Use.Description: Provide recommendations applicable to patients with or at risk of developing cardiovascular disease.
Intended Use.Focus: U.S. medical practice, adaptable as needed worldwide.
